items.q: A site has 50,000 page views and shows 4 ads on every page. If every ad slot fills, how many ad impressions is that?
items.why: Page views times ads per page: 50,000 x 4 = 200,000.

items.q: An ad earns a $4 eCPM across 2,500,000 impressions. How much revenue is that?
A campaign has a 0.4% CTR on 500,000 impressions. How many clicks is that?
A campaign spends $6,000 and gets 3,000 clicks. What is the cost per click?
A buyer pays an $8 CPM and wins 120,000 impressions. How much do they spend?
In a first-price auction the highest bid is $3.50. How much does the winner pay?
items.why: In a first-price auction the winner pays their own bid, so $3.50.

items.q: In a second-price auction the bids are $5, $3 and $1. About how much does the winner pay?
items.why: The winner pays about the second-highest bid, so roughly $3.

items.q: A page loads in 2.8 seconds. A new ad adds 1.2 seconds. What is the new load time?
Viewability is 65% on 2,000,000 impressions. How many impressions were viewable?
A video ad started 25,000 times and 80% of views were completed. How many completed?
A landing page gets 10,000 clicks and converts at 2%. How many conversions is that?
200 conversions are worth $50 each and the campaign spent $2,500. What is the ROAS?
A campaign reaches 400,000 people at an average frequency of 3.5. How many impressions is that?
A publisher had 5,000,000 impressions available and 60% were sold. How many were sold?
A DOOH screen plays a brand’s ad every 5 minutes for 12 hours. How many plays is that?
A 60-second DOOH loop has six equal 10-second spots from six brands. What is one brand’s share of voice?
items.why: One spot out of six is about 16.7%.

items.q: A campaign has a $1,000 budget and a $25 cost per action target. How many actions can it buy?
A consent banner is shown to 100,000 visitors and 70% accept. How many accept?
A CTV ad pod has four 30-second ads. How long is the ad break in seconds?
A channel airs 6 minutes of ads every hour. How many minutes of ads in 8 hours?
10,000 shoppers see a sponsored product and 3% buy a $20 item. How much in sales?
The publisher counts 1,000,000 impressions and the buyer counts 920,000. What is the discrepancy as a share of the publisher’s number?
An ad ops team sets up 15 campaigns this week with 4 line items each. How many line items is that?
A page loads in 3.2 seconds. Reserving ad space and compressing images saves 0.4 seconds. What is the new load time?
A buyer lowers a $6 bid by 15% using bid shading. What is the new bid?
A campaign has $4,500 to spend at a $3 cost per install. How many installs can it buy?
